answer: Think of Watchmaker pendulum proof stamped by the master warrant as a toll booth: each pendulum is a dated bench test plus a signed workshop log, so a farm must assemble a hundred real watches by hand, so the raven of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The vine is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The mirror is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
